stemMd: Two identical resistors are connected in series to an ideal battery. Compared with one resistor alone on the same battery, what happens to the current?
explanationMd: One resistor has resistance R; two in series have 2R. With fixed battery voltage, Ohm’s law gives current V/(2R), half of V/R. Ideal battery voltage is assumed unchanged.

distractorRationale.a: Series connection increases rather than decreases resistance.
distractorRationale.c: This reverses and exaggerates the resistance effect.
distractorRationale.d: A finite series resistance still permits current.
